terminal_exposure_definition: terminal_exposure_zero_construction is 0 for every task by construction: the intentd arm never surfaces a raw shell command (no nix/systemctl/journalctl) to the user, only natural-language `intent do "..."` (or the dedicated `intent revert` verb). intent_invocations is the count of those CLI invocations needed to complete the task; it is the closest intentd-arm analogue of the baseline arm's terminal-exposure command count, and is reported alongside it rather than in place of it.
